policy.adaptive_runtime: Parameters, recipe population, structural features and bounded current-instance decision archive may adapt during this solve; historical fit/quality tables are not loaded.
policy.freeze_boundary: Freeze optimizer source, metadata inputs, initialization banks, budgets/methods/seeds before formal TEST. Do not freeze per-instance evolved runtime state.
policy.offline_LLM_role: Initialize bounded typed recipe banks/operators from TRAIN development/failure context; no online LLM call and no historical winning ranking programme is deployed as the algorithm.
policy.current_instance_evidence: Any current conditional calculation, witness/alias check and feature mutation is solver work inside the same total CPU budget, not a free pre-solve oracle.
policy.main_metric: Final complete feasible schedule value_ticks/1000000 seconds with exact integer objective; same-source/config/budget/seed paired method deltas.
policy.budget: Total parent plus native-child CPU includes input load, initialization, patches, scoring, controller, evidence, all failed candidates and final validation. Declared and actual CPU/overshoot/wall are retained.
policy.anytime: Only true incumbent commit events. Native trace unavailable is observation-limited, not no progress; no interpolation.
policy.statistical_unit: r008/r009 physical groups. AU/AP,8configs and seed2 are repeated observations; expose both groups, equal weighting, no pseudo-independent CI/significance.
policy.failure_policy: Preserve missing/nonfeasible/failed jobs, raw negative gain, guard-rejected trials, programme errors, feature costs and zero updates; missing quality is NA not zero.
mechanism_metrics: actual declared-feature reads in scoring separated from diagnostic reads
policy.dataset_scope: Same complete contacts and exact duration weights under8resource configurations; satellite gap150 fixed. Four independent TEST libraries form only2physical groups.
limitations: custom STK geometry and EOP forecasts
ground W/E axis only; no claim of effective independent satellite-gap axis

feedback_operators.json.validation: strict typed declarations only; no scoring/quality selection

grammar_operators.json.validation: strict typed declarations only; no scoring/quality selection

witness_operators.json.validation: strict typed declarations only; no scoring/quality selection

input_contract_check: Graph metadata,byte hashes,same-source node/weight hashes only; no NPZ arrays loaded.
execution: Queue runs8single-CPU workers with allowed affinity; all methods same declared total CPU; no queue launched by registration.
